package e2e

// 两份正式生成工程共用进程/Redis/HTTP观察辅助，不改业务状态。
import (
	playerentity "OPERATIONS_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	svcaccount "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/account"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/mongo"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// ownRedis 只持有本用例启动的进程。AOF always + 同目录重启，不清游标/待发/平台订单。
type ownRedis struct {
	t         *testing.T
	dir, addr string
	cmd       *exec.Cmd
	done      chan error
}

func operationsSuite(t *testing.T) (*suite, *ownRedis, string) {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_MONGO_URI") == "" || os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_NATS_URL") == "" {
		t.Fatal("private Mongo and NATS required: run the operations/activity real script")
	}
	base, err := strconv.Atoi(env(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_PORT_BASE"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r := &ownRedis{t: t, dir: t.TempDir(), addr: fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", base+350)}
	t.Cleanup(func() { r.stop() })
	r.start()
	t.Setenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_REDIS_ADDR", r.addr)
	control := t.TempDir()
	t.Setenv("OPERATIONS_CONTROL_DIR", control)
	s := newSuite(t, 8*time.Minute)
	return s, r, control
}

func (r *ownRedis) start() {
	r.t.Helper()
	_, port, _ := strings.Cut(r.addr, ":")
	f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(r.dir, "redis.log"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		r.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r.cmd = exec.Command("redis-server", "--bind", "127.0.0.1", "--port", port, "--dir", r.dir, "--appendonly", "yes", "--appendfsync", "always", "--save", "", "--daemonize", "no")
	r.cmd.Stdout, r.cmd.Stderr = f, f
	if err := r.cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		r.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r.done = make(chan error, 1)
	go func(cmd *exec.Cmd, done chan error) { done <- cmd.Wait(); _ = f.Close() }(r.cmd, r.done)
	c := goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{Addr: r.addr})
	defer c.Close()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if c.Ping(context.Background()).Err() == nil {
			r.t.Logf("private Redis ready pid=%d appendonly=yes appendfsync=always same_dir=%s", r.cmd.Process.Pid, r.dir)
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	r.t.Fatal("private Redis not ready")
}

func (r *ownRedis) stop() {
	if r.cmd == nil {
		return
	}
	_ = r.cmd.Process.Kill()
	select {
	case <-r.done:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		r.t.Error("owned Redis did not exit")
	}
	r.cmd = nil
}

func operationsAdmin(s *suite, p *proc, name, operator string, payload any, ok bool) map[string]any {
	s.t.Helper()
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"name": name, "operator": operator, "trace_id": "operations-" + name, "payload": payload})
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(s.ctx, http.MethodPost, "http://"+p.ops+"/admin/execute", bytes.NewReader(raw))
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Admin-Token", "dev-gm-token")
	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var answer struct {
		OK   bool           `json:"ok"`
		Data map[string]any `json:"data"`
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(out, &answer); err != nil || answer.OK != ok {
		s.t.Fatalf("GM %s ok=%v: HTTP %d %s: %v", name, ok, resp.StatusCode, out, err)
	}
	return answer.Data
}

func operationsPlayerDoc(s *suite, sid int32, id int64) (bson.Raw, error) {
	full, err := entity.BuildEntityID(id, playerentity.EntityKindPlayer)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mongo.Database(fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d", s.prefix, sid)).Collection("player").FindOne(s.ctx, bson.M{"_id": full}).Raw()
}

func operationsNumber(raw bson.Raw, path ...string) int64 {
	v := raw.Lookup(path...)
	n, ok := v.AsInt64OK()
	if !ok {
		return -1
	}
	return n
}

func operationsMove(s *suite, from *proc, id int64, to int32) {
	s.t.Helper()
	data := operationsAdmin(s, from, "gm.player.rehome", "operations", map[string]any{"player_id": id, "to": to, "note": "private operations acceptance"}, true)
	if data["accepted"] != true || data["transfer_id"] == "" {
		s.t.Fatalf("rehome only admission receipt missing: %v", data)
	}
	accounts, err := svcaccount.NewBusClient(s.bus, "", 0)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.eventually("account final serving binding", 30*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		binding, err := accounts.RoleBinding(s.ctx, id)
		return err == nil && binding.ServingServerID == to && binding.Transfer == nil, fmt.Sprintf("binding=%+v err=%v", binding, err)
	})
	s.eventually("source documents dropped after successful handoff", 15*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		raw, err := operationsPlayerDoc(s, from.sid, id)
		return len(raw) == 0 && errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments), fmt.Sprintf("source bytes=%d err=%v", len(raw), err)
	})
}
